case_name: Ajinkya Dhananjay Mirkhelkar vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others

parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Maharashtra And Others

facts_of_case: Petitioner v. Respondents — full case name

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has not been living with them as husband and wife for a period of three years or more.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has not been living with them as husband and wife for a period of three years or more.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant divorce on the ground of desertion unless it is proved that the other party has not been living with them for a period of three years or more.
legal_principles.held: This Court holds that the court will not grant divorce on the ground of desertion unless it is proved that the other party has not been living with them for a period of three years or more.

outcome.final_order: Case posted on 29th January 2022 for passing decree of divorce on mutual consent.
